page.overview:
Who is Alexia Sinister?

Alexia Sinister, also known as Alexis Sanister and other variations, is an Adventurers Dino Island minifigure introduced in 2000.

Her hair is black and goes down along the sides. She has a stern face with red lips, along with additional printed hair. Her torso is grey and has a white shirt underneath, along with multiple pouches on her belt. Her pants are black.

By the Dino Island subtheme, Adventurers character names were more internationally consistent than in the previous Egypt and Jungle subthemes. However, Alexia Sinister has a number of different spellings and variations of her name across different sources, largely coinciding with her brother's name in the same subtheme.

A LEGO Media document describing the storyline of the Dino Island gives her the name Alexia Sanister, which is consistent with her brother (alternatively known as Mr. Hates) sometimes being called Sam Sanister in the same document. This is the name used in 5778 LEGO Racers 2, along with her brother being named Sam Sanister in the game game. Similarly, while she is not named in-game, the script for 5730 LEGO Island 2: The Brickster's Revenge also names her Alexia Sanister, although her brother retains Mr. Hates as his name.
